claim: AWS will discontinue support for AWS App Mesh on September 30, 2026. After that date you can no longer access the App Mesh console or App Mesh resources. AWS points App Mesh users to a blog post named Migrating from AWS App Mesh to Amazon ECS Service Connect.
question: When does AWS App Mesh support end, and which ECS feature does AWS point users to?

values.display: Migrating from AWS App Mesh to Amazon ECS Service Connect

note: AWS App Mesh is out of scope as an answer; Amazon ECS Service Connect is the answer. Other pages (ECS Anywhere considerations, EKS history of 2023-09-29) say App Mesh integration is unsupported there or for existing customers only.

evidence.quote: End of support notice: On September 30, 2026, AWS will discontinue support for AWS App Mesh. After September 30, 2026, you will no longer be able to access the AWS App Mesh console or AWS App Mesh resources. For more information, visit this blog post [Migrating from AWS App Mesh to Amazon ECS Service Connect](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/containers/migrating-from-aws-app-mesh-to-amazon-ecs-service-connect).

claim: Amazon ECR basic scanning uses AWS native technology to scan container images for software vulnerabilities, and it sources more than 50 data feeds to generate findings for common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs).
question: Which technology does ECR basic scanning use, and how many data feeds does it source?

evidence.quote: Amazon ECR basic scanning uses AWS native technology to scan your container images for software vulnerabilities. Basic scanning provides vulnerability detection across a broad set of popular operating systems, sourcing more than 50 data feeds to generate findings for common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs).

claim: The default failure threshold type of the ECS deployment circuit breaker is BOUNDED_PERCENT with a default value of 50. ECS multiplies the value by the latest service desired count, and the result is clamped to a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 200.
question: What is the default failure threshold of the ECS deployment circuit breaker?
note: Configurable thresholds came with the What's New post of 2026-07-01 (see ecs-change-configurable-circuit-breaker-2026-07). Examinable but very recent: label Changed recently.

evidence.quote: Amazon ECS multiplies `value` by the latest service desired count to calculate the failure threshold. The result is clamped to a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 200. This is the default type with a default value of 50.
